actors.name: Sunmark housing cooperative board
actors.private_context: The board has called a special general meeting for September 12 to vote on amending the pet policy. They are aware of the two-thirds member turnout requirement in the bylaws. They have sent notices to all members about the meeting and the proposed amendment.

actors.name: Sunmark housing cooperative members
actors.private_context: Each member has received notice of the special general meeting on September 12 regarding the pet policy amendment. Members have varying levels of interest in the pet policy and may or may not plan to attend. Some members may be unable to attend due to other commitments.

shared_context: Sunmark housing cooperative's bylaws require a two-thirds turnout of all members for a special general meeting to be valid. The special general meeting is scheduled for September 12, 2026. The meeting will decide on a proposed amendment to the pet policy. Members have been notified of the meeting and the agenda.

starting_events.description: The Sunmark housing cooperative board has called a special general meeting for September 12 to vote on amending the pet policy. Notices have been sent to all members.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that at least two-thirds of all Sunmark housing cooperative members actually attended (or were represented by proxy, if allowed) the special general meeting on September 12, 2026, before the meeting's conclusion. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
